conflictResolutions: Default/Advanced/Classic are workspace presets inside Lightroom desktop 10.0; they do not imply Lightroom Classic catalog behavior.
Older import/export and shortcut examples establish behaviors only when consistent with the November release and current documentation.
PNG and WebP export/import may be useful LopeOS extensions; their implementation is not proof of Adobe desktop support.
A documentation feature illustration is not pixel-level fidelity evidence.
